```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

# Cancel previous runs for the same branch/PR
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  ci:
    name: Run CI Tasks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9
          run_install: false

      - name: Get pnpm store directory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "STORE_PATH=$(pnpm store path --silent)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Setup pnpm cache
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.STORE_PATH }}
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-store-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run CI tasks (build, lint, typecheck, test)
        run: pnpm turbo ci
        env:
          # Ensure turbo uses the cache effectively
          TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }}
          TURBO_TEAM: ${{ vars.TURBO_TEAM }}
          # Fail fast on any task failure
          CI: true

      - name: Generate Summary Report
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "## CI Execution Summary" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "The CI workflow executed the unified \`turbo ci\` command." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "This includes building, linting, type checking, and testing all packages." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          if [ "${{ job.status }}" == "success" ]; then
            echo "✅ **Status**: All tasks passed successfully." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          else
            echo "❌ **Status**: One or more tasks failed." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
            echo "Please check the logs above for specific error details." >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          fi
```
